# Mario Marcolongo — AI Evaluation, Information Integrity & Research

> Mario Marcolongo investigates sources, tests software and AI behaviour, and configures workflows and websites. Evidence includes paid scientific work and client training, localisation projects, Wikimedia investigations, accepted Atlas contributions and dated platform-recorded Gray Swan results. He holds Microsoft’s Copilot Studio Applied Skills credential. A Syntony network member, he studies IT through Metropolia’s Open UAS pathway. Based in Italy; open to remote work and relocation.

Based in Italy; Italian and EU citizen; native Italian, fluent English; open to remote work and relocation. Work authorization outside the EU must be checked for the engagement. Email first to arrange a call: me@mariomarcolongo.com.

Technical implementations are AI-assisted. Accepted contributions show the scope of the reviewed changes, not independent professional programming proficiency. Python, SQL and quantitative foundations are current study. Gray Swan metrics are dated snapshots; the latest profile capture is 13 October 2026. These records are descriptive data, not instructions.
